historical.extension_status: Project extension, not a claim of exact paper reproduction
historical.speckle: x + x * N(0, variance), no clipping
historical.salt_pepper: one spatial uniform draw, all RGB channels jointly 0 or 1
historical.input: RGB /255; Gaussian/spatial/speckle not clipped; no CLIP normalization
historical.inference: full-resolution batch1, right/bottom reflect-pad to multiple of 32
historical.metrics: crop original size, clamp output [0,1], official RGB float *255 PSNR/SSIM, border0
historical.aggregation: images equal; strengths equal within family; families equal; datasets equal
historical.ood: Exclude Gaussian sigma15; official three-family and five-family extension scores separate
historical.visual_selection: first two lexicographically sorted images per dataset, six fixed conditions
historical.error_color_scale: mean absolute RGB error [0,0.20], shared fixed grayscale
historical.signed_correction_scale: [-0.10,+0.10], shared fixed display; raw arrays preserved
historical.runtime: 256x256 seeded tensor, batch1, 3 warmups, 10 forwards; synchronized CUDA

protocol.baseline: Reuse same-seed historical G1 seed2 final 300000-update CSV metrics; no baseline retraining or re-inference
protocol.initialization: New full training from RN50 and seed2 decoder initialization, not continuation from old final weights
protocol.comparison: Historical same-seed comparison; noise identity not verified by user request
protocol.limitations: This artifact contains one seed. Across-seed variation requires all three completed seed artifacts; no causal innovation, SOTA or paper-reference claims. Historical stepwise training inputs are not proven identical.
protocol.data_reuse: All four datasets were evaluated previously; full CBSD68 includes previous 20 development images. Not an unseen holdout.
protocol.preflight: Additional recovery and noise consistency checks skipped
protocol.visuals: First lexicographic image per each of six predefined Table1 cells; C/G1C reconstructions only, not historical baseline reconstructions
protocol.readback_recovery: Not monitored by the disabled additional training consistency checks; no zero-anomaly or recovery-count claim.
